children: The December 11–13 edition at Bharat Future City will feature comics, anime, gaming, cosplay, live music, international guests and the Hyderabad chapter of Indie Game Utsav
Hyderabad Comic Con is set to return from December 11–13, 2026, with a three-day celebration of comics, anime, gaming, cosplay, music and pop culture at Bharat Future City.

Presented by Maruti Suzuki and powered by Crunchyroll, the event is being organised by NODWIN Gaming and will bring together fans, creators and pop culture communities through gaming zones, creator interactions, comics, anime and interactive experiences.

The 2026 edition will also mark the first time Hyderabad Comic Con is part of the Invest Telangana Global Summit and the third year of its partnership with India Joy, both initiatives of the Government of Telangana.

Shefali Johnson, CEO, Comic Con India, says Hyderabad’s strong storytelling culture and enthusiastic fandom community make it an important market for the event. She draws a parallel between the city’s traditional Cheriyal scroll paintings, which use sequential visuals to tell stories, and the storytelling traditions of comics and graphic narratives.

Akshat Rathee, Co-founder and Managing Director, NODWIN Gaming, says Hyderabad’s connection with storytelling, from Telugu cinema to traditional art forms such as Oggu Katha and Burrakatha, makes it a natural setting for a modern pop-culture celebration.

A key addition to this year’s event will be the Hyderabad chapter of Indie Game Utsav, giving independent game developers an opportunity to showcase their creations to gamers and international publishers.
The three-day programme will also feature international guests, live music, stand-up comedy, immersive brand experience zones, gaming activities and other fan-focused experiences.

With comics, anime, gaming, cosplay and live entertainment forming the core of the programme, Hyderabad Comic Con 2026 is set to bring the city’s pop culture communities together for another weekend of fandom and shared experiences.
